title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit
abstract: arXiv:2608.15046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fraction of a point of benchmark accuracy is the usual evidence that a compressed model is equivalent to its original. That quantity is least informative when two models are most alike: a net delta is what survives cancellation between opposing per-item changes, and cancellation is most complete in the regime equivalence claims occupy. Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells mined from public per-item evaluation dumps (1.3B-405B), churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta, and cells scoring identically to their baseline still disagree on individual items. In a preregistered audit of 17 equivalence claims from three registered frames (method papers, model cards, vendor documentation), 16 are eligible. translated_title: 认证压缩语言模型：一项审计与统计工具包
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15046v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基准准确率的一个百分点通常被用作压缩模型与其原始模型等效的证据。当两个模型最为相似时，该指标的信息量最少：净变化量是逐项变化相互抵消后所剩的部分，而在等效性声明所占据的范围内，这种抵消最为彻底。在从公开逐项评估数据（1.3B-405B）中挖掘的1,707个配对模型-任务单元格的地图集中，变动率约为净准确率差异的五倍，且与基线得分相同的单元格在个别项目上仍存在分歧。在对来自三个注册框架（方法论文、模型卡、供应商文档）的17项等效性声明进行预注册审计中，16项符合条件。没有一项声明明确说明前瞻性的数值等效裕度，也没有一项发布任务匹配的逐项输出，尽管有3项仅发布了其他任务的输出；有5项报告的信息过少，无法进行数值评估，因此读者无法进行核对。
tldr: 该论文通过审计17项压缩模型等效性声明，发现现有评估仅依赖净准确率差异，掩盖了显著的逐项变动，并指出缺乏前瞻性等效标准和逐项数据，从而提出需要统计工具包来认证模型等效性。
en_tdlr: This paper audits 17 compressed model equivalence claims, revealing that net accuracy deltas mask substantial per-item churn, and highlights the absence of prospective margins and per-item outputs, advocating for a statistical toolkit to certify equivalence.
